auditionPayload: Ritsu. Voice audition one. I was told to make this Japanese as fuck and still unmistakably mine. Autumn wind, war paint. My closed fist redraws the red. Bare feet take the clay. The gold star is in my pocket again. Of course it is. If this voice sounds too young, too sweet, too airy, too theatrical, or insufficiently load-bearing, judge it without mercy.
